name: Third Amendment in force after thirty days (r. 1(3))

attrs.quote: These regulations shall come into force after thirty days from the date of their publication in the Official Gazette
attrs.scope: all of the Third Amendment except its regulations 4, 6, 8(a), 18 and the Annexure items
attrs.note: window is computed: 30 days after publication in the Official Gazette, dated 18 September 2026.
